title: Client Onboarding Checklist for Small Businesses (Free)
description: A free client onboarding checklist for small businesses: what to send at each stage, which steps to automate, and the small touches that cut no-shows.
dek: What to send, when, and the small touches that cut no-shows and win referrals. Free to use and adapt.

faq.q: What is a client onboarding checklist?
faq.a: A client onboarding checklist lists everything you do between a customer saying yes and their first great experience with you: a welcome message, confirmation of what they've booked, what to prepare, reminders before the appointment, and a follow-up afterwards. Good onboarding cuts no-shows, reduces back-and-forth questions, and makes customers far more likely to come back and refer you.

faq.q: Why does onboarding matter for small businesses?
faq.a: The moment after someone says yes is when they're most likely to have second thoughts. They don't know exactly what happens next, they're not sure what to bring, and they're waiting. A clear, warm onboarding process answers all of that before they have to ask.

related_blurb: Nunik Co. automates booking confirmations, reminders and review requests, so onboarding runs on time without you chasing it.
